desc:
🌕Welcome to your night shift, Sorcerers.

At Jujutsu High, you will inspect visitors and let them through the cursed barrier by checking their IDs and stamping their permit papers.
But be careful, as there are reports of curses categorized as Anomalies trying to get into the school, and their intentions are unknown.
Soon enough, you'll realize that the man known as Suguru Geto may not be who he seems.

prequel to freaky gojo.
